name: 27501 · Angier, NC
findings: ZIP 27501 (Angier) has 44 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 27501 (Angier) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 27501 (Angier) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 61% of all organizations here have no identified type.
